podcast.body: The release of this single in February 1967 is noted as a potential trigger for the collapse of The Beach Boys' Smile project. Brian Wilson reportedly felt that The Beatles had achieved what he was desperately trying to accomplish. "el lanzamiento del single Strawberry Hills Forever de los Beatles, en febrero de 1967, al sentir que ellos habían logrado lo que él tanto ansiaba."
